description: Patrol: Lane Sweep: radio lead-in, calls and sign-offs.

briefing: Three beacons on your beat. Fly close to each and hold. Report anything odd.
Routine patrol of {system}. Visit the beacons, log them, go home.
{client} wants the lane beacons checked. It should be dull.
success: Beat complete. {client} logs the sweep and pays {captain}.
failure: Patrol abandoned. The beacons go unchecked.
You are driven off the beat. {client} files a short report.
radio-beats: First beacon is ahead. Close in and hold.
Beat begins. Beacon on the nose.
Beacons are marked on your display. Start with the nearest.
radio-trouble: Contacts, far side. Three, closing. Not on the schedule.
Unidentified fighters. They are not friendly.
{enemy} ships have found your patrol. Deal with them.
